Kill [[Fendi Nin]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Fendi Nin in the [[Shards of Orr]].
* *BONUS* Kill Fendi Nin in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Asura reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[Lost Souls#Walkthrough|Lost Souls]].
